The proposed answer of 6 is wrong; the correct answer is **8**, because the solution's arithmetic is off from n = 4 onward.

For n sides the interior angles sum to (n−2)·180°, so the missing angle is x = (n−2)·180° − 1070°. In a convex polygon, x must satisfy 0° < x < 180°.

| n | (n−2)·180° | x | Valid? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 720° | −350° | No (the solution wrongly got 70°) |
| 7 | 900° | −170° | No |
| 8 | 1080° | 10° | Yes |
| 9 | 1260° | 190° | No (more than 180°) |

So the only valid value is n = 8, with a missing angle of 10°.

VERDICT: REJECT
